Now the question pose at before me is, when and whom the alleged blood sample have been collected from accused No.1 and at what time, place, on which particular date and before whom including under which particular temperature the alleged blood sample have been collected from accused No.1.
Further before collecting the alleged blood sample from accused No.1 whether it took the prior permission of accused No.1 also one more crucial factum need to be adjudicated.
If it go through the case record to finds the truth on each of the factum herein above raised, the case of prosecution have take its own silence with respect to each and every fact in issue.

The same such of the silence of the prosecution case as well as the admissions caused in the deposition of PW7 make itself created a doubt on the case of prosecution with respect to Ex.P39 certificate.

With this being of observation,
either the testimony of PW7 or Ex.P39 certificate not in the way to point out the guilt of accused No.1 for the offence punishable under section 185 of I.M.V. act.
Admittedly the case registered in against accused Nos.1 and 2 under section 279, 304 and 304(A) of I.P.C. along with section 185 of I.M.V. Act.

For the above all reason it found the result with respect to accusation in against the accused Nos.1 and 2 and what for the reason the benefits of doubts of the prosecution extended to accused Nos.1 and 2.

Since case registered in against accused Nos.1 and 2 under I.M.V. Act the legal representatives of deceased are not entitled any of the benefits under section 357(A) of Cr.P.C. as the same compensation could traced by them at before Motor Accident Claims Tribunal.
Accordingly, I answer point Nos.1 to 4 in the Negative.
